newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - LONDON-BASED ARAB NEWSPAPERS - AUG 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - LONDON-BASED ARAB NEWSPAPERS - AUG 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian President Arafat says Israel wants to create confrontation among Palestinians.
- Two Israeli raids on Lebanon's Bekaa.
- Saudi Arabia approves new regulations for companies wanting to go public in the kingdom.
- Iran rejects Iraqi president's call for improving relations between the two countries.
- Yemen's interior minister to visit Saudi Arabia for talks on border dispute between the two countries.
- Gulf Investment Corporation says it has direct investments in 22 projects worth around $2.7 billion.
- Egypt plans to increase number of hotel rooms to 200,000 by the year 2000.
